title: Ministry of Panchayati Raj Launches 'DAANVEER' Citizen Participation Portal for Gram Panchayats
summary: Ministry of Panchayati Raj Launches 'DAANVEER' Citizen Participation Portal for Gram Panchayats

items: Enables individuals and Indian diaspora to voluntarily donate computers to nearly 2.5 lakh Gram Panchayats via 'Meri Panchayat' app and DigiHaat.
Technical Partners: Developed in collaboration with National Informatics Centre (NIC) and DigiHaat.
